text:
maria: heads-up: eu-west spike ~02:15 UTC — autoscaler opened burst to ~220% for ~18m. several spot preempts and a big egress blip to feature-store. we need guardrails.
jordan: saw it too. GPU-hours +45% vs baseline overnight, cost ~= $4k. dashboards: https://grafana.example.org/d/teams/infra/region-eu-west
akshay: current policy is 'burst: 3x, cooldown: 5m' — that's way too permissive for mixed workloads. we should bound by budget not just ratio.
maria: quick proposal: add per-pool "burst_budget" (gpu-hours/day) and a "sustain_window" so if burst lasts > sustain_window it gets cut back toward steady. also enforce a steady floor.
lisa: agree. prefer soft-throttle for best-effort workloads (queueing) instead of hard kill so we avoid preemptions.
sam: can implement. draft YAML for discussion:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  pools:
    - name: gpu-a100-eu
      steady: 40            # guaranteed GPUs
      burst: 1.5             # multiplier over steady
      burst_budget_gpu_hours: 100
      sustain_window_seconds: 600
      soft_throttle: true
```
akshay: also need region-level holdback to keep ~10% reserved for enterprise SLA traffic, and a global safety cap when inter-region egress spikes.
oncall-bot: Incident #1789: preemptions spike detected 2025-10-02T02:18Z -> alerted oncall, triage started.
jordan: :thumbsup: test plan: A/B on staging with these limits for 48h then roll to prod if metrics stable.
maria: i've opened an RFC doc (https://docs.internal/rfcs/guardrails-burst) and scheduled 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC. @sam can you draft the PR with config + the list of metrics to watch?
sam: yes. will include PromQL for preemptions, egress_per_request, queued_requests, avg_p50_p95_latency and a simple cost burn projection. ETA: 1d + 0.5d for metrics dashboards.
lisa: add chaos test to staging to simulate region blackout and ensure holdback triggers.
sam: will add chaos test and runbook steps (rollback: set burst -> 1.0 and disable soft_throttle).
akshay: one more: queueing fallback must respect per-customer min throughput (enterprise min tokens/sec). add per-customer override tags.
maria: sounds good. temporary operational decision: set prod burst cap to 1.6x for eu-west until PR merges and we can monitor for 72h. i'll update runbook and notify support teams.
jordan: thanks — keep the cost calc in the PR.
lisa: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
maria: closing action items: sam -> PR + metrics, akshay -> update routing/reserve rules, lisa -> add chaos test, jordan -> prepare rollout plan. follow-up in RFC + tomorrow sync.
